courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射
related.transfer: 可遷移「突發模式超導加速與射頻脈衝預算」與「掠射反射鏡的臨界角、面形預算與熱凸起」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Burst-mode superconducting acceleration and the RF pulse budget" and "Grazing mirrors: critical angle, figure budget and thermal bumps" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦突發模式超導直線加速、可變間隙 SASE 波盪器、掠射 X 光光學與 MHz 偵測器的系統工程；SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射則以SASE 自由電子雷射的增益、束流壓縮、單發診斷與 LCLS-II 超導升級為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on systems engineering of burst-mode superconducting acceleration, variable-gap SASE undulators, grazing-incidence X-ray optics and MHz detectors; SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source centres on SASE gain, bunch compression, single-shot diagnostics and the LCLS-II superconducting upgrade, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「1.3 GHz 超導直線加速器與脈衝列」與「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「SASE 統計、同調時間與脈衝能量抖動」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “1.3 GHz superconducting linac and pulse train” and “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "SASE statistics, coherence time and pulse-energy fluctuation", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 超導加速腔製作
related.transfer: 可遷移「突發模式超導加速與射頻脈衝預算」與「掠射反射鏡的臨界角、面形預算與熱凸起」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；超導加速腔製作的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Burst-mode superconducting acceleration and the RF pulse budget" and "Grazing mirrors: critical angle, figure budget and thermal bumps" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦突發模式超導直線加速、可變間隙 SASE 波盪器、掠射 X 光光學與 MHz 偵測器的系統工程；超導加速腔製作則以1.3 GHz 鈮九腔的 BCS 表面電阻、Q₀、材料與表面處理到低溫垂直測試的工程鏈為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on systems engineering of burst-mode superconducting acceleration, variable-gap SASE undulators, grazing-incidence X-ray optics and MHz detectors; Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication centres on BCS surface resistance, Q₀, niobium material, surface treatment and 2 K vertical testing of 1.3 GHz nine-cell cavities, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「1.3 GHz 超導直線加速器與脈衝列」與「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到超導加速腔製作，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「頻率、場平坦度與失諧預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “1.3 GHz superconducting linac and pulse train” and “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Frequency, field flatness and the detuning budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射
history.text: European XFEL 建立在 DESY 主導的 TESLA 超導加速技術與漢堡 FLASH 自由電子雷射的經驗上，FLASH 驗證了以超導直線加速器驅動的 SASE 在軟 X 光波段可行。European XFEL GmbH 於 2009 年成立並開始土建，3.4 km 的隧道設施於 2017 年首次產生雷射並開放使用者實驗；之後持續擴充實驗站與 MHz 偵測器。本課只重建公開原理與設施公開資料，不涉及任何操作程序。
history.textEn: European XFEL builds on the TESLA superconducting-acceleration technology led by DESY and on the FLASH free-electron laser in Hamburg, which proved that SASE driven by a superconducting linac works in the soft X-ray range. European XFEL GmbH was founded in 2009 and civil construction began; the 3.4 km tunnel facility first lased in 2017 and opened to user experiments the same year, after which instruments and MHz detectors kept expanding. This course reconstructs only public principles and published facility data, not any operating procedure.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「突發模式超導加速與射頻脈衝預算」到「機器保護、束流功率與營運交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Burst-mode superconducting acceleration and the RF pulse budget" through "Machine protection, beam power and operational handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
